cars.f.title: What
cars.f.nextDueHint: Leave empty to use the car's interval.
cars.f.paidHint: Filled in from litres × price − discount; type the receipt amount to have the discount worked out instead.
cars.odo.hint: Every odometer value from all entries. Fill-ups, service etc. are edited in their own tab; manual readings here.
cars.f.discountHint: Filled in when you type the paid amount and it is more than 0.10 below litres × price.
cars.f.validUntilHint: Set to one year after the done-on date; change it if yours differs.

health.noPeople: No people to show — add household members under People, or ask an admin for access.
health.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? Its files, reminders and cost in Finance go too.
health.f.doseTimesHint: Type a time and press Enter, e.g. 08:00, 20:00. Empty = no dose reminders.
health.doses.title: Medicine doses
health.doses.none: No doses planned for this day.
health.files.title: Files
health.files.drop: Drop a PDF or photo here, or click to choose
health.files.limits: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC · up to 25 MB
health.files.failed: Upload failed — only PDF and images up to 25 MB are accepted.
cabinet.title: Medicine cabinet
cabinet.deleteMedicineConfirm: Delete this medicine and all its boxes?
cabinet.search: Search: name, substance, what it's for…
cabinet.empty: The cabinet is empty — add the medicines you keep at home.
cabinet.f.name: Medicine
cabinet.f.minAgeHint: e.g. 3, or 72 for 6 years. Empty = no limit.
cabinet.f.dosageHint: e.g. children 5 ml every 6–8 h, max 4× a day
cabinet.p.daysAfterOpeningHint: From the leaflet, e.g. 28 for eye drops, 14 for syrups.
cabinet.d.strengthHint: Dosing by body weight — optional, from the leaflet. E.g. 100 mg…
cabinet.d.strengthVolumeHint: e.g. 5 for “100 mg / 5 ml”. Empty = strength per tablet/sachet.
cabinet.d.doseHint: Fill this, or the ml per kg below.
cabinet.calc.title: Dose by weight
cabinet.calc.noWeight: No weight recorded for this person yet — add it in Health history → Weight & height.
cabinet.calc.warn.no_rule: No dosing by weight on file for this medicine.
cabinet.calc.warn.too_young: This person is younger than the minimum age for this medicine.
cabinet.calc.warn.capped_single: Limited to the maximum single dose.
cabinet.calc.warn.capped_daily: Limited to the maximum daily dose.
cabinet.calc.warn.below_quarter_unit: The dose is less than a quarter tablet — use another form (e.g. syrup).
cabinet.calc.disclaimer: Helper calculator — always check the leaflet or ask a doctor. Amounts are rounded down.

people.archiveConfirm: Archive {{name}}? Their history stays; they disappear from lists.
people.f.name: Name
health.f.medicineHint: Pick from the cabinet or type a new one — it's added to the cabinet.

health.profile.bmiChild: For children BMI is read on age percentile charts.
cabinet.links.noPurchases: No purchases linked — pick this medicine when adding the expense in Finance.
finance.field.medicineHint: Link the purchase to a medicine so it shows in the cabinet.
health.f.forConditionHint: The visit shows up in that event's window.
cabinet.calc.noRuleYet: {{name}} has no weight-based dosing yet (e.g. 15 mg/kg). Fill it in and the calculator will work out the dose.
cabinet.calc.notInCabinet: “{{name}}” isn't in the cabinet yet. Add it with its weight-based dosing (e.g. 15 mg/kg) and the calculator will work out the dose.
household.title: Home
household.f.name: Name
household.f.minQuantityHint: Below this it goes on the shopping list. Empty = never.
household.archiveConfirm: Remove this product? Its purchase history is kept.
household.empty: No products yet. Add the first one.
household.shopping.tickHint: How much did you buy? It'll be added to the stock.
household.tile.nothingExpiring: Nothing expires in the next 3 days.

notes.quickPlaceholder: Add a note or reminder… e.g. “tomorrow 18:00 buy milk”, “in 40 min cake”
notes.empty: No notes yet. Type something above.
notes.f.title: Title
notes.defaultTime: Without a time we'll remind at 9:00.
notes.filesAfterSave: Save the note to add files.
notes.onlyOwnSelectable: Only your own notes can be selected — shared ones can't be archived or deleted by you.
assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.noConversations: No conversations — start a new one.
assistant.empty: Ask about spending, the car, stock, notes… You can also add a photo of a receipt, odometer or invoice.
assistant.placeholder: Type a question… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line)
assistant.noAccess: You don't have access to the assistant.
assistant.notConfigured: The assistant isn't set up yet.
assistant.askAdmin: Ask an admin to set it up.
assistant.f.name: Name
assistant.f.title: Title
assistant.noConnection: Can't reach the dashboard's server. Check that it's running and try again — if the message did get through, you'll see it after refreshing the page.
assistant.sent.title: What was sent to the model
assistant.sent.hint: Exactly what the model received for this answer. In the cloud, names and personal data are replaced by aliases like [P1].
settings.nothingForYou: There is nothing to set up for your account here.
settings.ai.title: Settings — AI
settings.ai.localProfileHint: For private conversations and local-only modules.
settings.ai.fileProfileHint: The default model for messages with a photo or PDF; another can be picked in the chat.
settings.ai.privacyHint: Per module: may the assistant use it, and may the data go to the cloud. In the cloud, names, PESEL, phones, e-mails and addresses are replaced by aliases, and an age is sent instead of a birth date.
settings.ai.documentsHint: Photos and PDFs can't be anonymised — they are sent as they are.
settings.ai.f.name: Name
settings.ai.f.apiKeyKeep: Stored — leave empty to keep it.
settings.ai.f.apiKeyOptional: Usually not needed for a local server.
settings.ai.f.locationHint: "Local" only for a model running on your network — it gets data without aliases and serves local-only modules.
settings.ai.modelHint.openai: Model name from your OpenAI dashboard.
settings.ai.modelHint.google: Gemini model name from Google AI Studio.
settings.ai.modelHint.ollama: A pulled model's name (see: ollama list), e.g. llama3.1.
finance.split.ok: The parts add up to the amount.
finance.recurring.title: Repeating payments
finance.recurring.hint: Each payment is added on its date. Set up new ones in the transaction form ("Repeat").
finance.charts.title: Finance charts
finance.charts.dragHint: Drag across the chart to pick a period.
investments.title: Investments
investments.dragHint: Drag across the chart to pick a period.
investments.kindHint.gold: Valued daily at the NBP gold price (pure metal — dealers may pay less). Enter the fine-gold weight, e.g. a 1/10 oz coin = 0.1 oz.
investments.kindHint.crypto: Valued daily from CoinGecko (in PLN). Fractions allowed, e.g. 0.05 BTC.
investments.kindHint.stock: Valued daily from Yahoo Finance (in the listing currency, converted at the NBP rate). Without a symbol you enter the value yourself.
investments.kindHint.bond: Value computed from the bond's rules; later years follow GUS inflation + margin. Before tax and early-redemption fee.
investments.kindHint.other: E.g. a deposit, savings account, silver, IKE. With an interest rate the value is computed (before the 19% tax); without, you enter it whenever you like.
investments.f.name: Name
investments.f.coinHint: e.g. bitcoin, ethereum — as in the coin's page address on coingecko.com.
investments.f.marginNbp: Later months: NBP reference rate + margin.
investments.firstPurchase: First purchase (you can add it later)
investments.cryptoHistoryNote: Free CoinGecko history goes back one year — before that the chart shows the purchase amount.
investments.setValueHint: E.g. from your broker app. The chart connects the values you enter.
investments.archiveConfirm: Hide this investment? Its history is kept.
investments.periodsHint: Interest rate in each period. If your bank shows a different one, enter it — it replaces the computed rate.
investments.inflation.title: Inflation (GUS)
investments.inflation.hint: CPI y/y (same month a year earlier = 100). Downloaded from GUS daily; if that fails you can enter it by hand.
investments.inflation.none: No data yet — it appears after the first GUS download.
finance.recurring.scopeQuestion: This is a repeating payment. Where should the changes go?
finance.recurring.backfillHint: The date is in the past — payments from then until today will be added right away.
finance.recurring.editHint: Changes apply to the next payments. Recorded ones stay as they are (edit them one by one, or "this and all following").
finance.recurring.frequencyHint: A new frequency applies from today.
investments.refreshHint: Gold (NBP), crypto (CoinGecko) and inflation (GUS) — also fetched every evening.
investments.refreshErrors: Some prices couldn't be fetched — try again later.
investments.f.rateHint: E.g. a deposit or savings account. Empty = you enter the value yourself.
investments.compounding.none: at the end of the term
finance.categories.title: Categories
finance.categories.mergeHint_one: Its {{count}} transaction, repeating payments and bookmarks move to the chosen category, and this one is removed.
finance.categories.mergeHint_other: Its {{count}} transactions, repeating payments and bookmarks move to the chosen category, and this one is removed.
investments.kindHint.silver: Valued daily at the silver price (COMEX, USD converted at the NBP rate). Enter the fine-silver weight.
investments.f.tickerHint: As on finance.yahoo.com: SPY (US), CSPX.L (London), SXR8.DE (Xetra), CDR.WA (Warsaw).
investments.f.metalUnitHint: Fine-metal weight of the coin / bar.
investments.sharingHint: Only you see this investment unless you share it.
finance.categories.hasSubHint: It has sub-categories of its own, so it stays a main category.
finance.categories.mergeSubHint: Its sub-categories move to the chosen category too.

settings.ai.modelHint.openrouter: Pick from the list — it only shows models that can use the assistant's tools. Image icon: the model reads photos.
settings.ai.openrouter.privacy: Requests only go to providers that don't collect prompt data. If a model has no such provider (free models don't), the assistant shows an error. Data still goes with aliases, as to any cloud model.
settings.ai.openrouter.modelsError: Couldn't load the model list — type the id yourself, e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-4.5.
settings.ai.f.cloudOnly: This is an internet service, so it's always “cloud”: it gets data with aliases and never local-only modules.
investments.fxNote: Amounts in {{currency}} at the NBP average rate of {{date}}: 1 {{currency}} = {{rate}} PLN. Purchases and values are entered in PLN.
investments.fxError: Couldn't get the NBP rate — showing amounts in PLN.
settings.ai.f.allowDataCollection: Allow providers that may store prompts
settings.ai.f.allowDataCollectionHint: Needed for free models (:free). Such providers may keep prompts or train their models on them.
settings.ai.openrouter.mayStore: Requests may go to providers that keep them or train models on them. They go with aliases in place of names and personal data, and modules set to “local only” (health and notes by default) never go here. Your OpenRouter account (openrouter.ai/settings/privacy) must allow such models too.
settings.ai.openrouter.freeNeedsSwitch: This is a free model: without the switch above the chat shows an error.
investments.sellFifoHint: Oldest purchases first (FIFO, as the tax office counts it). The sold part stays in the purchase list as its own row with its share of the cost.
investments.sellLotHint: Selling only part? Enter how much — that part becomes its own row with its share of the purchase cost.
investments.sellTooMuch: More than was held that day
investments.sellWholeBonds: Bonds are sold whole — enter a number of bonds, no more than held
investments.sellPreview: Purchase cost of this part: {{cost}} · result: {{gain}}
investments.fxRateNbp: NBP average rate of {{date}} — the last working day before the transaction, as for tax. You can enter your broker's rate.
investments.fxRateError: Couldn't get the NBP rate — enter the rate.
finance.bulk.title: Change many transactions
finance.bulk.splitHint: Replaces a split between people, if there was one.
finance.bulk.wrongKind: {{count}} of them have a category of the other kind (income / expense) — their category stays.
finance.import.title: Import transactions
finance.import.formatHint: Columns are found by their header names: Data / Date, Category, Podkategorie, PLN, Income/Expense, Opis, Notatka, Kwota, Currency (e.g. a Money Manager export). Opis becomes the transaction's name and Notatka its note. Transfers between accounts are skipped.
finance.import.paste: …or paste rows from a spreadsheet, with their header
finance.import.error.too_big: The file is too big (5 MB at most).
finance.import.error.xls: That's the old .xls format — save the file as .xlsx or CSV.
finance.import.error.columns: No date and amount columns found — check the header.
finance.import.skipDuplicates: Skip those already here (same day, amount and name)
finance.import.reason.type: not clear if income or expense
finance.import.categoriesHint: Missing ones are created (with sub-categories). You can point them at existing ones instead.
finance.bulk.matching: Every transaction matching the filters above the list — {{scope}}.
finance.charts.words: Words in the name / notes (Enter after each)
finance.charts.filtersHint: The filters apply to every chart. “For whom” counts only those people's parts of split transactions, and “Shared (household)” the unsplit ones.
finance.charts.lines.label: Chart lines
finance.charts.lines.categoryHint: A line for each category picked in the filter (a main one with its sub-categories); none picked: the biggest main categories.
finance.charts.lines.personHint: A line for each person picked in the filter (their parts of transactions) and “Shared (household)”; none picked: everyone.
finance.charts.lines.termHint: A line for each word in the filter.
finance.charts.lines.noWords: Type words in the filter (Enter after each) to compare them on the chart.
auth.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an admin for a link to set a new one.
setup.title: Welcome to Home Dashboard
setup.intro: This is a new install. Create the first account — it gets full admin rights. You'll add the family in the next step.
setup.name: Your name
setup.nameHint: How the family will see you, e.g. “Mum” or “Mateusz”.
setup.family.title: Family
setup.family.subtitle: Step 2 of 2 — add your household. People without their own login (e.g. small children) go here too; you can change everything later in People and Settings.
setup.family.name: Name
setup.family.loginHint: They get a link to set a password — send it e.g. in a message.
invite.intro: Set a password for your account {{email}}.
invite.invalid: It has been used already or has expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
users.subtitle: Who can log in, with which roles
users.f.name: Name
users.f.rolesHint: Roles add up; details in “Roles and access”.
users.f.personHint: Who they are in the family — “only themself” in access means this person.
users.f.newPerson: A new person with this name
users.f.activeHint: A switched-off account can't log in (its data stays).
users.f.activeSelf: You can't switch off your own account.
users.mainAdminHint: The main admin always has full access — roles and exceptions change nothing for them.
users.linkHint: A link (the chain icon) works once, for 7 days — send it to the person and they set a password. It also works for a forgotten password.
users.exceptionsHint: For this account only, on top of its roles — e.g. deny finance, or allow one person's health until a date.
users.noExceptions: None — this account has exactly what its roles give.
users.link.hint: Send it to them (text message, chat…). It works once, until {{until}}. It's shown only now — make a new one if needed.
roles.subtitle: What each role may see and do
roles.howItWorks: An account gets the grants of all its roles plus its own exceptions (in Accounts). A deny wins: it takes away its level and every level above. Built-in roles can be changed but not deleted.
roles.name: Role name
roles.deleteConfirm_one: Delete this role? {{count}} account will lose it.
roles.deleteConfirm_other: Delete this role? {{count}} accounts will lose it.
access.f.dataWindowHint: Optional — e.g. health history only from 2024 on.
access.f.validUntilHint: Optional — it stops working after that day.
access.levelHint.manage: Everything, including the module's settings (e.g. adding people).
access.denyHint: A deny takes away this level and every level above it, whatever the roles give.
access.subjectsHint.self: Only the person linked to the account (e.g. a child sees their own health).
account.passwordRule_one: At least {{count}} character, not just a common word or only digits.
account.passwordRule_other: At least {{count}} characters, not just a common word or only digits.
account.forgotHint: Don't remember your current password? An admin can make you a link to a new one (Settings → Accounts).
problem.unknown: Something went wrong — please try again.
problem.forbidden: You aren't allowed to do this.
problem.password: This password doesn't follow the rules.
problem.password_entirely_numeric: The password can't be only digits.
problem.password_too_similar: The password is too similar to the name or email.
problem.already_set_up: The dashboard is already set up — log in.
problem.email_invalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
problem.email_taken: An account with this address already exists.
problem.person_taken: This person already has another account.
problem.deactivate_self: You can't switch off your own account.
problem.inactive: This account is switched off — switch it on first.
problem.link_invalid: This link has been used already or has expired.
problem.lose_admin: This change would take away your admin rights — undone.
problem.role_taken: A role with this name already exists.
problem.builtin_role: A built-in role can't be deleted or renamed.
problem.grant_owner: A grant belongs to a role or an account.
problem.dates_order: The period starts after it ends.
